visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a narrow, semi-outdoor market alleyway filled with lush green potted plants of various sizes. The path leads toward a small stall with a warm, inviting glow from interior lights. (2) The camera moves closer to the stall, which features a wooden countertop and several stools. A customer is seen sitting at the counter, while a male staff member wearing a black t-shirt and a face mask works behind the bar. (3) Inside the small kitchen area, another staff member in a grey shirt and cap is actively frying food in a large metal wok filled with bubbling oil. There are stainless steel shelves and various kitchen tools in the background. (4) The scene shifts to close-up shots of the prepared food. A male hand uses tongs to place golden-brown fried items into a metal tray. Later, a hand shakes a clear seasoning bottle to sprinkle pepper over the snacks arranged on a ceramic plate. (5) A series of extreme close-ups follow, showcasing individual fried items being held up with a fork or tweezers. One shows a cross-section of a fried roll containing a slice of hard-boiled egg. Another reveals a white, textured interior with bits of vegetable or seafood. (6) A piece of fried food is dipped into a vibrant yellow sauce on a small wooden tray. Next, a hand places a clear glass filled with a red sparkling drink and ice cubes onto the wooden counter. (7) A hand reaches out to take a takeaway bag. The food is packed in a brown paper bag which is then placed inside a clear plastic handle bag. (8) The final shot is a close-up of a white sign with black text, partially obscured by green vines, displaying the name of the establishment and its location details.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你知道高雄鹽埕市場裡. (2) [Subtitle]: 藏著傳承四代的旗魚黑輪嗎. (3) [Subtitle]: 這間七十多年的小店. (4) [Subtitle]: 專做新鮮旗魚的手工炸物. (5) [Subtitle]: 每一份都是現點現炸. (6) [Subtitle]: 簡單加上胡椒粉調味. (7) [Subtitle]: 我們點了全炸綜合. (8) [Subtitle]: 能一次吃到所有炸物. (9) [Subtitle]: 有招牌的蛋黑輪. (10) [Subtitle]: 軟嫩帶點蛋香. (11) [Subtitle]: 還有滋味鮮香的花枝捲. (12) [Subtitle]: 有芹菜香氣的蝦捲. (13) [Subtitle]: 是用豆皮製作. (14) [Subtitle]: 我們最愛脆脆香濃的牛蒡黑輪. (15) [Subtitle]: 也吃得到旗魚丸. (16) [Subtitle]: 或旗魚肉丸. (17) [Subtitle]: 可以搭配沾醬享用. (18) [Subtitle]: 這裡也有供應. (19) [Subtitle]: 爽口的氣泡飲. (20) [Subtitle]: 他們家可以外帶喔. (21) [Subtitle]: 快去吃吃看. (22) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. (23) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉. (24) [Slogan]: 山壹旗魚食製所 鹽埕第一公有市場 高雄市鹽埕區新樂街213號之19號.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A traditional market stall renovated with a modern, cozy wooden aesthetic. The entrance is lined with abundant tropical plants. The interior is a functional kitchen with stainless steel equipment and a wooden service counter.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice begins the narration over a bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM track with a steady 4/4 beat. The vocal delivery is fast and enthusiastic. (2) As the narration continues, subtle ambient room tone and very faint market chatter can be heard in the background, though well-balanced beneath the main vocal. (3) A soft, percussive sound of an object being moved or placed on a wooden surface occurs during a brief gap in speech. (4) The narrator describes various food items, her tone rising in pitch for emphasis. The BGM remains consistent with its driving synth bassline. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect is used to transition between descriptions, adding a rhythmic punctuation to the mix. (6) The video ends with a cheerful closing statement from the narrator, the music fading slightly as the recording cuts.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction of Location -> Detailed Showcase of Menu Items -> Recommendation/CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce and promote a historical fish paste snack stall in Kaohsiung's Yan Cheng Market, emphasizing its tradition and the quality of its fried items to attract tourists and food enthusiasts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed filming of products, mention of specific store location and history, and direct recommendation by the creators.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-frequency cuts and macro close-ups to create a sense of 'food porn,' effectively highlighting textures. The contrast between the old market setting and the modern, plant-heavy stall aesthetic appeals to younger audiences looking for 'aesthetic' local gems.
